mentions.name: Market Diary
mentions.description: A market journaling app for logging daily market thoughts, documenting trades, and reviewing charts in one place. Powered by Markdown, it supports file attachments, team collaboration, and TradingView charts, with free signup.
mentions.problem: Investors need a single place to log market thoughts and document trades to turn noise into alpha.
mentions.audience: Solo investors and teams who want to turn market noise into alpha.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still very early, but I’ve been building Market Diary - https://marketdiary.io. Log daily market thoughts, document trades, and review charts all-in one place. Built for solo investors and teams who want to turn noise into alpha. Powered by Markdown, supports file attachment, teams, and TradingView charts. Free to signup.
